description: For B2B outreach: tell which Brazilian business mobile numbers the user already has (a company's or a decision maker's, from a sheet or a search) have WhatsApp, so a campaign only writes on WhatsApp to numbers that can receive it. It returns only yes, no or unknown per number: no name, profile or message. Up to 100 numbers per call, in any format. Charged 3 credits per number that has WhatsApp, once per number; nothing for the others. has_whatsapp is null when the number is not Brazilian or could not be checked (never read null as no).
name: check_whatsapp
title: Checar WhatsApp
